summary: Backend (5/5 pytest cases) and frontend (nav, hero, FAQ, contact form valid+invalid, services/stats render) all passing on the deployed preview URL. Contact form successfully persists leads to MongoDB; validation errors return 422; GET /api/contact returns leads sorted newest first with _id excluded.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `logger` is referenced in create_lead (line 53) but defined below at module level (line 77). Works at runtime because it's evaluated lazily, but poor style — move logger config above route definitions.

Portfolio uses data-testid `project-{i}` and Pricing uses `plan-{i}` while the review_request references `portfolio-card-*` and `pricing-plan-*`. Naming is inconsistent with request but not a functional bug. Consider aligning testid conventions.
No CORS_ORIGINS restriction configured (defaults to '*'). Acceptable for public marketing site but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: Test leads created via POST /api/contact with prefix TEST_ (name field). Not cleaned up (no DELETE endpoint exists).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All spec-required flows are validated. Backend endpoints: POST/GET /api/contact plus GET /api/. Frontend: Lenis smooth scroll works, all data-testid selectors used in review_request are correct except portfolio/pricing which use `project-{i}` and `plan-{i}`. Hero heading renders correctly with neon-yellow 'OUR TECH.' accent. 14 services cards render, stats visible, FAQ toggle works.
